_upstream.body_excerpt:
Support remote credential masking with Zsh shell snapshots

## Why

Remote credential masking previously supported only Bash commands without login startup or shell snapshots, leaving Zsh commands with unmasked credentials.

## What changed

- Enable masking for Zsh login commands using shell snapshots on Linux and macOS.
- Capture trusted startup profiles per launch, bind the credential broker to the resulting environment, and replace credentials and supported aliases with placeholders before snapshot replay.
- Preserve explicit environment overrides, credential unsets, and launcher-managed proxy settings during replay.
- Warn and fall back to unmasked startup when a snapshot cannot safely replay credentials; stop execution if protected snapshot restoration fails.

## Testing

Extend remote execution tests for inherited and profile-defined credentials, overrides, destination changes, and unsupported-profile fallback. Add a Zsh scenario snapshot showing a credential placeholder in command output.
